claim_boundary: Peer-reviewed evidence reports that lower time-varying Bitcoin-equity correlation predicts higher next-day Bitcoin returns. This does not establish that a static lagged 63-paired-business-day Bitcoin-Nasdaq correlation threshold improves DRA V1 economics. Exactly one frozen matched-capital historical screen may test the zero-correlation primary with -0.10 and +0.10 stability neighbors. Any timing, economic, predictive, breadth, drawdown, holding, inventory or neighbor failure closes the exact family without changing correlation window, index, direction, thresholds, parent or accounting.

feature_contract.formula: Pearson correlation across the latest 63 paired observations of NASDAQCOM close-to-close return on business date D and BTC complete UTC-day close-to-close return on the same calendar date; both legs must be known before D plus one day 00:00 UTC.

prior_matrix.finding: The study reports that a decrease in Bitcoin's time-varying correlation with S&P 500 returns strongly predicts higher next-day Bitcoin returns, while an increase predicts lower returns.
prior_matrix.identity: Yae and Tian, Volatile safe-haven asset: Evidence from Bitcoin, Journal of Financial Stability 73, 101285 (2024)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The paper uses S&P 500 and model-estimated time-varying correlation, not NASDAQCOM, a fixed 63-pair Pearson window, a zero threshold, DRA signals or after-cost strategy economics.

prior_matrix.finding: FRED publishes NASDAQCOM as the daily Nasdaq Composite market-close index and identifies the underlying source as Nasdaq, Inc.
prior_matrix.identity: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED, NASDAQCOM
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The sealed 2018-2024 copy is present-vintage and copyrighted; original revision vintages remain MISSING_PROOF.

real_time_design_requirements: Reuse the already sealed NASDAQCOM response and unchanged pre-2025 BTC H1 selection corpus; do not download or repair either source after outcome access.
Construct BTC complete UTC-day closes and pair only dates with a published NASDAQ close; skip holidays and missing rows without interpolation.

Freeze a 63-paired-business-day Pearson correlation evaluated once per ISO week at that week's last published Nasdaq business date, primary threshold 0.00, neighbors -0.10 and +0.10, relation AT_OR_BELOW, and next-day 00:00 UTC eligibility.
Keep DRA side, entries, exits, lot cost, capacity, fees, adverse slippage, cooldown and fill clock unchanged.
Require matched-capital Design and Validation economics, path risk, intervention support, annual breadth, concentration, independent predictive breadth and both-neighbor stability.
Treat present-vintage source timing as development evidence only; any historical pass requires untouched future evidence.
prohibited_substitutions: Do not replace NASDAQCOM with S&P 500, QQQ, futures or a blended equity index after outcome access.
Do not change 63 paired business days, once-per-ISO-week evaluation, correlation estimator, threshold direction, next-day lag or missing-pair policy.
Do not reinterpret the permanently closed NASDAQ trend family as support; this is a distinct joint-diversification mechanism.
Do not add volatility, trend, EPU, VIX, dollar, gold or regime interactions.
uncertainty: A fixed-window Pearson correlation is only a coarse proxy for the paper's time-varying correlation model.
NASDAQCOM is more growth- and technology-heavy than the S&P 500 used in the cited study.
Low correlation can reflect BTC-specific distress rather than valuable diversification demand.
The result may be dominated by 2020-2021 adoption or 2022 deleveraging and fail annual breadth.
No correlation values, BTC strategy outcome, post-2024 evidence, OOS, candidate, canonical write or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
